shortdesc: Simple live Cups for 2–8 racers: one track pick each, finalist scoring, smooth POV spectating, PB and record panels.

0.2.1: Integrate PolyCup into the native in-game toolbar, including native scaling, hover styling and auto-hide.
Move the race leaderboard into the top corner when the native toolbar disappears; reserve space when it returns.
Keep buttons readable across hover, focus and disabled states; fix disappearing dark-text labels.
Match native italic ForcedSquare typography, kerning, navy surfaces and slanted panel, tab, button and field shapes.
Preserve the Simple Cup format, records, car skins and buffered POV spectating.
